absent: Full field layouts of the page encryption descriptor, runtime data, save area, communication block, emulation context, register state, attribute change descriptor and real mode header.
Exclusion ordering and nesting rules for the memory encryption lock beyond the stop conversion entry point.
Hypervisor call ABI details for processor creation and destruction, guest address registration and register forwarding beyond the call sites shown.
Page table helper semantics for address lookup, level size and mask computation, entry construction and atomic installation.
Translation flush timing requirements and paravirtual table layout beyond the two flush indirections shown.
Recovery behavior for failed private conversions, failed mappings and failed save area promotion beyond the return codes shown.
Initialization ordering for communication blocks, privilege level assignment and timestamp scale values.

findings.text: A caller supplies a descriptor carrying page level, kernel entry location, desired encryption direction and optional virtual address. The helper resolves the backing frame and current protection for that level, derives a new protection with the encryption attribute set or cleared, reports no work when resolution fails or protection is unchanged, otherwise publishes the physical address and level span and ensures cache coherence over the affected range before the caller installs a fresh entry built from frame and new protection atomically.

Frame and protection lookup is defined only for three page granularities corresponding to small, medium and large mappings. Any other level triggers a one time warning and yields a zero frame to signal failure. When the caller provides an output slot, the current protection value for the selected level is stored there.

Cache eviction over a virtual range is presented as an ordered operation with a barrier before and after delegation to an optimized range primitive, so callers observe completion ordering relative to surrounding memory accesses.

The directly mapped upper bound is the mapped frame count scaled to bytes. The decrypted test holds when canonical decryption leaves the entry value unchanged. Default confidential computing helpers for marking encrypted or decrypted are identity mappings that preserve the input value.

Global translation invalidation checks for a preemptible context, then selects a global invalidate when the global pages feature is present and a local invalidate otherwise. Both paths dispatch through a paravirtual operations indirection for kernel versus user flush handling.

Halting shared versus private conversions uses a write oriented exclusion object. Crash context attempts a nonblocking acquisition and reports contention as failure, while normal context waits for ownership and reports success. The kexec entry path invokes this halt and logs a warning on failure while still proceeding.

The kexec begin gate is inactive unless the platform reports a secure nested paging guest and the kexec core is enabled at build time. When active it only attempts to stop ongoing conversions, never blocking a crash path.

Secure nested paging kexec teardown moves through quiescing conversions, shutting down application processors, reprivatizing the direct map and decrypted loader data, flushing translation caches globally, disabling further hypervisor calls through the boot communication block, and finally reprivatizing per processor communication pages at containing page granularity with hypervisor notification.

Mappings that contain a per processor communication page must be skipped during the bulk reprivatization sweep and handled last, otherwise the protocol used for hypervisor notification would switch prematurely to a slower path. Application processor shutdown must skip absent virtual machine save areas and must not attempt tag removal for the running processor, instead marking its backing page as excluded from dump collection.

Segment attribute baselines encode present state combined with descriptor type, with code variant adding readable and executable properties, data variant adding writable property, and table variants encoding distinct system types. These values initialize save area segment descriptors for early application processor state.

Save area backing avoids a large page reverse map erratum by allocating two zeroed contiguous frames on the target node, releasing the first frame that might carry large alignment and returning the second frame as the usable save area. Allocation failure yields a null result.

Secondary startup through a hypervisor exit requires hypervisor support for creation, requires the supplied start address to match the known trampoline and then substitutes the protected entry point, allocates a fresh save area, initializes segment, table, control, floating and timestamp state from architectural defaults while preserving machine check control from the current control register, applies virtual interrupt and timestamp extensions when the corresponding platform features are present, assigns virtual privilege level and shifted security status, promotes the page to save area type and requests creation, replacing any prior save area. Distinct failures are reported for unsupported creation, unexpected start address, allocation failure and promotion or creation errors.

Secondary wakeup override for secure nested paging is installed during early initialization whenever that guest type is present, making hypervisor assisted creation the required start method. One build updates the override slot, live dispatch table and static call site with an informational message, while the alternate build performs no action.

Application processor jump table setup is a no operation when no table address is published, fails when the address lacks page alignment, otherwise maps one encrypted page at the aligned base, programs startup offset and selector derived from trampoline headers into the first two slots, unmaps and reports success, with a distinct error when mapping fails.

Early firmware mapping of communication structures is a no operation without guest state encryption, otherwise maps each per processor communication page as present with execute disabled and writable attributes without encryption, and when a virtual privilege level is active additionally maps the corresponding secure vendor communication address as encrypted. The underlying page table helper requires execute disable support, warns when more than one processor is online, adjusts clear and set masks with encryption handling, applies the change and flushes all translations.

Secure interrupt controller register access and guest address registration share a pattern of acquiring the per processor communication block under interrupt safe guarding, invalidating it, performing either a register emulation call or a registration hypercall, then releasing. Register addresses derive from a base plus a shifted register number with values split across two halves. Register failures are fatal and terminate the guest, while address registration returns the hypervisor call status and optionally outputs the previously registered address.

Model specific register emulation dispatches vendor communication address accesses locally with writes absorbed and reads returning the current per processor address halves, routes timestamp related accesses to secure timestamp handling when that platform feature is active, rejects secure interrupt controller control access when secure interrupt virtualization is active, otherwise forwards the request to the hypervisor and on successful reads copies the returned halves into the saved register state.

Secure timestamp handling treats all writes as general protection faults, rejects frequency identifier reads as hypervisor errors, and satisfies counter reads with an ordered timestamp split into low and high halves.

Ordered timestamp reading selects among plain, fenced and counter with auxiliary forms according to processor features to prevent speculative reordering relative to memory accesses. Assembly helpers have two width variants with separate halves combined by shifting on narrow builds and a single wide value on wide builds, and the two option patching macro is expressed as nested single option patches.

Control register reading is a direct move on wide builds where the register always exists, while narrow builds use a fault tolerant sequence that yields zero through an exception table fixup when the register is absent.

All secure interrupt controller communication block uses hold an interrupt save scoped guard from acquisition through release, preventing interrupt reentry from observing a partially programmed block.
Per processor communication block registration resolves the current processor runtime data and registers the physical address of its embedded communication page through the early registration path.
